note: optax.clip_by_global_norm(0.1) on the critic gradient before Adam (optax.chain), both arms identically; NCE, actor loss, bc 0.05, learning rates, Adam and everything else unchanged.  Threshold from the spike trace: pre-spike critic gradient norms median 0.017 / 0.033, p99 ~0.055 / 0.096; the triggering impulses 0.92 / 2.53.  An optimizer-stabilisation change, disclosed as such -- not the original learner
held_fixed: dataset, anchors and weights, CF branches, critic and actor streams and seeds, losses (NCE + actor loss, bc 0.05, random_goals 0), critic learning rate 3e-4, twin-Q architecture, initialisation (fresh paired critics, actor from the start agent), 30,000 optimizer updates, gamma 0.999, evaluation (300 natural draws, seed 3909, mode); both arms O and CF, seeds 0-2
motivation: diag_replay/spike/SUMMARY.md: the walking collapses are critic runaways -- one critic gradient impulse on an ordinary batch, Adam keeps x10-15 steps, all logits shift down on fixed data, the actor is dragged 12-20 updates later; with the critic frozen the actor does not collapse.  Both arms have the events.  First remedy: clip the critic gradient (global norm 0.1) before Adam, identically in O and CF; not a proven fix, disclosed as an optimizer-stabilisation change.

criteria.0_training_stability: no logged spike in any of the 6 runs: every 500-update log row has critic loss < 0.02 and mean positive logit > -20 (the base runs: CF 0.133 / 0.120 / 0.362 at 4.5k / 2.5k / 6.5k, O s1 0.21 at 8k); and the critic still learns (critic loss at 30k at the base level ~0.007, categorical accuracy comparable)
criteria.1_primary: CF(variant) - O(variant) success on the 300 common episodes, per paired seed; rule: mean > 2 x seed s.e. and 3/3
criteria.2_detour: CF(variant) - O(variant) detour rate 3/3 positive; death / timeout / hazard success reported
criteria.3_vs_base: CF(variant) - CF(base) and O(variant) - O(base) success and timeout (does the stabilisation remove the walking loss?)
criteria.4_continuation: from the SAME detour-entrance handover states of diag_traj (cont.json enter_detour): reach rate of CF(variant) vs CF(base) and the start policy
criteria.readings: no spikes + walking kept + detour and success up = the runaway was the limit; no spikes + walking kept + no detour = a route-learning question, to be examined without training collapses; spikes remain = the clip does not bound the Adam step, next candidate is a bound on the actual update

no_selection: the variant is evaluated once with its final checkpoint; no tuning of the rate after seeing the result
